{{Quote|The easy way is always mined.|Pathfinder observation|<ref name="RoE" />}}
The '''Pathfinders''' were a specialist division of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]]. Skilled in stealth and reconnaissance, Pathfinders were dropped into enemy territory to perform forward scouting missions, or secure beachheads and landing zones for further ground assaults. Lightly armed and mobile, Pathfinders relied on surprise and finesse to achieve their mission objectives, lest they be overwhelmed by a larger, more organized enemy force.

==Organization==
[[File:SpecForce_Pathfinder_TCGSC.png|left|thumb|180pox|Pathfinder, [[Cael Hanarist]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]]]
The Pathfinders were a military speciality of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]].<ref name="RASB" /> The 2nd [[Regiment/Legends|Regiment]] of each individual [[Division/Legends|Division]] was designated as the Pathfinder regiment.<ref name="RoE" /> Pathfinders were deployed as the initial wave of an assault, inserted via covert drop into enemy territory via various means including [[Parachute/Legends|parachutes]]<ref name="RASB" /> and [[para-wing glider]]s<ref name="RoE" /> to establish beachheads and hold their position until relieved by stronger forces,<ref name="RASB" /> or to conduct reconnaissance missions.<ref name="RoE" /> Pathfinders traveled light, relying on total surprise to overwhelm the enemy before they realized that the Pathfinders were among them. However, it was a difficult undertaking to insert large forces with sufficient heavy weapons without being detected,<ref name="RASB" /> and were usually undertaken by small units, usually no larger than a [[Company/Legends|company]]. Relying on mobility and stealth,<ref name="RoE" /> a small number of Pathfinders were capable of causing havoc amongst the ranks of the enemy if they achieved total surprise. However, if the enemy was able to organize and regroup, they would be able to pose a real threat to the smaller Pathfinder force, risking annihilation unless relieved.<ref name="RASB" /> Pathfinders were also deployed in small units to act as scouts for other SpecForce units during ground operations. In these situations, the Pathfinders enjoyed the luxury of better reinforcements. Pathfinders also carried out reconnaissance and data retrieval mission at the behest of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]].<ref name="RoE" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a Pathfinder [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] was deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nishr]] after a [[Nishr Suppression|series of crackdowns]] against the native population, the [[near-Human]] [[Nish]], were conducted by local [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. The Pathfinders reported on the state of Imperial-Nish relations and marked potential base sites on the planet. Inside three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], the Pathfinders were joined by three [[Wilderness Fighters]] platoons; the resulting unit, the [[Nishr Taskforce]], was assigned to hinder Imperial operations on the world in attempt to draw reinforcements away from other locations in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]], and encourage the local [[Nishr Resistance|resistance]]. The taskforce's Pathfinders were mounted on [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], and frequently operated out of [[Nishr Base Ten]].<ref name="RoE" />

A Pathfinder platoon was assigned to [[Taskforce Shen]], an elite silent missions forces that operated throughout the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Taskforce Shen was commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Mart Stevez]], and was based around two [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrator]] platoons tasked with conducting silent raids, ambushes and tactical strikes. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Pathfinder platoon was commanded by Lieutenant [[Mishowan Shigormallan]].<ref name="RoE" />

[[Outpost Cinder]] was an Alliance field base staffed by [[Team Blade]] under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Teracca Torrh]]. The base was responsible for monitoring the [[Bid'jerma Detention Block]] on the planet [[Bid'jerma]], which housed Alliance prisoners, and to formulate a plan for their rescue.<ref name="HS" />

As the Galactic Civil War entered a state of conventional warfare, Pathfinders were expected to be deployed alongside [[Infiltrators]] to prepare beachheads and landing zones for invasion forces.<ref name="RoE" />

==Personnel==
[[File:Pathfinder-RoE.jpg|thumb|left|A Pathfinder]]
{{Quote|All right, let's set the beacons up and get this operation rolling.|A Pathfinder|<ref name="RoE" />}}
Pathfinders were generally natives of nondescript [[Planet/Legends|planets]], usually in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. As youths, they explored the rural wilds of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] extensively, and traveled far and wide gaining an appreciation for visiting new places while learning valuable navigation skills along the way.<ref name="RoE" /> Many of the [[Jiivahar]] that joined the Alliance were effective woodland Pathfinders.<ref name="J14">{{JournalCite|14|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref> Upon joining the Alliance, the acquired skills saw them assigned to SpaceForce Pathfinders. After [[drop camp]], Pathfinders spent two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] learning to survive in a variety of terrains, underwent stealth training, and learned how to operate [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles.<ref name="RoE" />

Self-reliant and practical, Pathfinders were calm and collected with little patience for the flashier Specs such as [[Heavy Weapons Specialists]], [[Marines (SpecForce)|Marines]], or [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], prefering to work with [[Infiltrators]] and [[Wilderness Fighters]]. Minimal contact with the enemy and low profile insertion missions were their stock in trade, as Pathfinders preferred to employ finesse over brute force. They were often referred to as "TrekSpecs" or "Trekkers" by other Specs.<ref name="RoE" />

During the Galactic Civil War, [[Team Razor]] was commanded by a [[Major/Legends|Major]], and was comprised of [[Razke]], [[Acle]], [[Reku]], [[Jal]], [[Henle]], and a rookie. Team Razor conducted the preliminary scouting and set-up for Outpost Cinder on Bid'jerma, while the Outpost's primary mission was conducted by Team Blade under Lieutenant Torrh.<ref name="HS" /> Lieutenant Shigormallen was a native of [[Yelsain/Legends|Yelsain]] who served with Taskforce Shen,<ref name="RoE" /> while [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Brooks Carlson/Legends|Brooks Carlson]] served with the [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] that destroyed the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CSWE-Carlson">{{CSWECite|I|109|Carlson, Sergeant Brooks}}</ref> During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Lilla Dade]] served as the Pathfinder in the elite [[Katarn Commandos]].<ref name="HESB" />

==Skills==
Pathfinders were trained extensively in stealth tactics, and in survival across various terrain types.<ref name="RoE" /> The possessed knowledge about the various [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]],<ref name="RASB2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> and how to scout through unexplored and unknown locations.<ref name="RoE" /> Combat training for Pathfinders included how to handle [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], as well as [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], blaster [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]], and vehicle mounted blasters.<ref name="RASB2" /> Basic training in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]] was provided for Pathfinders,<ref name="RoE" /> and they were skilled in the operation of [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]].<ref name="RASB" /> Technical skills, such as [[Computer/Legends|computer]] use, demolitions, and repair were not strongly focused on,<ref name="RoE" /> and Pathfinders were able to apply first aid when needed.<ref name="RASB2" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Pathfinders.jpg|thumb|right|Pathfinders inserting via parachute]]
Standard equipment for Pathfinders included blaster rifles,<ref name="RASB" /> at least two grenades,<ref name="RASB2" /> survival gear<ref name="RASB" /> and survival packs.<ref name="RASB2" /> Mission specific equipment included heavy weapons,<ref name="RASB" /> [[Flame Carbine|flame carbines]],<ref name="RoE" /> and available [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]]<ref name="RASB" /> such as speeder bikes; Pathfinders favored modified [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet]] [[Overracer]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]. Pathfinders employed [[camouflage poncho]]s for stealth, and, on occasion, light scout [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and climbing equipment. The [[Graph 18 surface locator]] was employed during missions, along with [[Portable beacon|landing beacons]]. [[ShadoWing-4]] [[para-wing glider]]s were used for insertion,<ref name="RoE" /> along with parachutes.<ref name="RASB" /> Pathfinders were also known to employ native riding beasts, such as [[Cracian thumper]]s. They also rarely employed [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], except for when absolutely necessary.<ref name="RoE" />
